openings.claim: Speculative floating edge cage may separate lateral registration from downward clamping friction, avoiding corner-lift tightening. Bolt four strips into two removable rubber-padded rim yokes with geometric hatch-edge stops allowing vertical movement; straps retain separation and cord recovers detached pieces.
openings.discriminator: If accessible rim/hatch edges support the geometry, expect within 1 mm under 20 N across ten closures including final right-contact 1 mm card disturbance; only seal continuity is exempt. Rival straps with increased corner pressure and no positive stops should require greater pressure or allow greater sliding. Record sliding and opposite-corner lift separately; identical results leave advantage unresolved.
openings.probe: Measure edge access, strap-routing length and achievable stop clearance first; abandon if supplied parts cannot fit. Retain hatch, rim and seal without drilling, cutting, gluing or permanent deformation; drill only strips, use no power. Allocate two rival closure/pull trials, one disturbed, and ten cage trials, final disturbed. Mark position; measure displacement with scale and ruler, corner lift, every reopening time, and inspect seal. Remove or swing every carrier outside full marked opening. Defeat if displacement exceeds 1 mm, reopening exceeds 30 seconds, carrier escapes retention, opening remains obstructed, seal tears, or adequate registration requires corner tightening.
openings.uncertainty: Unknown rim profile, edge access, hatch thickness, strap attachment and usable carrier clearance may prevent fabrication. Assumes supplied strips permit stops without forcing disturbed hatch flat; fabrication must fit ninety minutes and observation twenty. No load capacity or successful cycles established: enabling probe, not deployment.

lineage.reason: Relation, complete rival/discriminator, feasibility stop, defeat conditions, resource caveats, uncertainties and declared uncertain fit retained.

decision: Retain one conditional geometry probe. Supplied sliding and corner lift motivate separating registration from seal preload; neither proves success. Stipulated synthetic case and model proposal.
